description:
Advanced diagramming framework for Blazor, WPF, WinForms and Mac. Supports the following file formats: Visio Drawings and Stencils (VSDX, VSD, VSSX), AutoCAD Drawing Interchange (DXF), ESRI Shapefiles (SHP), SVG, EMF, PNG, JPEG, BMP, GED.

For more information visit:
https://www.nevron.com/dotnet-diagram

Documentation available at:
https://helpopenvision.nevron.com/

Blazor WebAssembly online demo:
https://blazorexamples.nevron.com/
title: NOV Diagram
